statement: The huge motionless red sun that appeared to be time's final stopped state is revealed across thousand-year strides to be still growing larger and duller toward a lifeless white-flecked beach without crabs.

contributors.role: provides the apparently final stopped state that is shown to keep changing
provides the prolonged thousand-year forward travel watching the sun grow larger and duller
provides the terminal outcome after more than thirty million years: crabs gone and beach lifeless and flecked with white

relationship: temporal progression and refinement: a seemingly final stasis is revised by prolonged onward travel into ongoing deterioration culminating in loss
justification: Motionless Red Sun presents the sun as huge, red and halted motionless, while Millennia-Long Sun Watching refines that stasis by showing the same sun growing larger and duller during thousand-year strides, and Crabs Gone Lifeless Snow gives the consequence of that onward journey: the crawling multitude has disappeared and the red beach seems lifeless and flecked with white. Together they revise motionlessness from endpoint into ongoing decline.
limitations: The units do not show the physical mechanism of the solar enlargement and dulling, whether the white flecking will persist, or the ultimate fate of Earth beyond this point.

statement: Although the machine's displacement from south-east to north-west is offered as physical proof of travel, the Traveller relinquishes a claim to belief by inviting his listeners to take his account as lie, prophecy, or mere story for judgment.

relationship: contrast
justification: Displacement alone would support a truth claim, and permission to disbelieve alone would suggest mere fiction, but together with the explicit request for judgment as a story they create a single stance: material proof is put forward at the same moment belief is declared optional.
limitations: The units do not show whether the listeners accept displacement as proof, nor which of lie, prophecy, or story the Traveller himself endorses.

statement: The Traveller's insistence that his incredible tale is literally true collapses into private reassurance, because he seeks confirmation from his scars and flowers while admitting his own disbelief and withholding the flowers, thereby licensing the listeners' restless dismissal of the tale as fiction.

contributors.role: provides the explicit insistence that the incredible story is true in every word
qualifies that insistence with admission of his own disbelief

provides the material token gazed at in mute inquiry
privatizes that material token by refusing to surrender it
recasts the account as fiction fit for a story-writer

relationship: contrast between assertion and self-doubt, and cause-and-consequence from privatized appeal to public dismissal
justification: True Despite Lying asserts literal truth, but Traveller doubts himself admits he hardly believes it himself, creating an assertion undercut from within. Scarred knuckles evidence and Withered white flowers show him appealing to body and flowers in mute inquiry as corroboration, while Refusal to give flowers shows him withholding the flowers from the Medical Man, turning potential public proof into private reassurance. Editor dismisses tale and Restless sceptical audience show that public reception becomes dismissal as fiction and restlessness. Together they yield a stalemate where insistence survives only privately because doubt and withholding license dismissal.
limitations: The units do not show the Traveller's motive for refusal, whether the audience inspected the scars, or whether surrendering the flowers would have persuaded anyone.

statement: The Time Traveller's abrupt vanishing into a three-year absence leaves the narrator with a black and blank future filled only by imagined prehistoric wanderings and by the shrivelled white flowers witnessing that gratitude and tenderness survived in man.

contributors.role: provides the sudden disappearance that initiates loss
establishes the loss as enduring and fruitless over three years
defines the resulting condition as black and blank ignorance
supplies speculative imagination that fills the blank absence
provides the contrasting surviving material witness of tenderness

relationship: cause and consequence with contrast
justification: Traveller's Abrupt Vanishing causes Three-Year Vain Waiting, together establishing final non-return. That prolonged loss yields Future as Black Blank as the narrator's condition, which is then filled only by Speculated Prehistoric Wanderings. Withered White Flowers Witness contrasts with that blank speculation as the sole persisting proof that gratitude survived, so together they form a closing of absence compensated only by speculation and memorial token.
limitations: The units do not show the Traveller's fate, whether return remains possible, or whether the flowers convince anyone besides the narrator.
